newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae buys Torralta, moves into tourism.
newsitem.headline: Sonae buys Torralta, moves into tourism.

text.p: Portuguese retail group Sonae signed an agreement with the government late on Wednesday to take over the state credits of loss-making tourism operator Torralta for 4.9 billion escudos.

Sonae, which has agreed to invest a further 28 billion escudos in the Troia tourism complex south of Lisbon, said that if the investment was successful tourism would become one of its principal activities.
During Wednesday's official signing ceremony Sonae said the investment would probably require a capital increase in its relatively small tourism unit Sonae Turismo by the end of the year.

Sonae will have a casino licence for the Troia complex. It will have to pay 10 percent of its gross earnings from gaming to the state during the first 10 years, 12.5 percent over the following five years and 15 percent in the final five years.
